text:
Fertilisers are used to provide the three elements needed for improved plant growth.
Which two compounds would provide all three of these elements?
A
ammonium nitrate and calcium phosphate
B
ammonium nitrate and potassium sulfate
C
potassium nitrate and calcium phosphate
D
potassium phosphate and potassium sulfate
subject: Chemistry
